name: Hollywood's Golden Age
description: The studio years, from silent comedy to Technicolor: the stars and directors who made the American film factory the world's main window on the movies.

checkpoints.name: Silent stars
checkpoints.note: Pickford, Chaplin and Keaton make a worldwide audience laugh without a word, and found studios of their own.

checkpoints.name: Sound and the studios
checkpoints.note: Talkies arrive and the big studios sign stars such as Garbo, Bogart, Gable and Bette Davis, while Hitchcock, Ford and Capra make a name for their directing.

checkpoints.name: Postwar glamour
checkpoints.note: Colour, widescreen and television bring change. Monroe, Audrey Hepburn and Taylor are the new stars, and Wilder and Hitchcock make some of their most famous films.

checkpoints.name: The method and after
checkpoints.note: Brando and Dean bring a more raw style of acting, and Sidney Poitier opens doors for Black actors as the old studio system breaks up.
